shared_qualifications: Fig.3 defines Eb (open diamonds) as final breakdown, and Einit (filled diamonds) as first repassivating-pit onset. Einit is assessed but is not interchangeable with the CRA final-breakdown summaries.

Supported shared rows link individual Eb readings to their material/temperature condition summary. A member need not equal CRA Avg, and no new mean is calculated. CRA Min/Max describe the curated spread, not an uncertainty attached independently to every registered observation.

Six partial observations have unresolved overlapping open/filled markers. Their values and recovery limitations are retained as candidate-only; no hidden replicate multiplicity or Eb/Einit pairing is inferred.
The source strip thickness is 3 mm (PDF p.7), versus 2 mm in the ordinary-heat CRA processing prose. Chemistry and test condition identify links independently of that context discrepancy.
